segments.name: income-producing properties
segments.description: Owns and operates New York City commercial real estate, mainly Manhattan office properties, earning rent from tenants.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it has one reportable segment, income-producing properties, which consists of activities related to investing in real estate.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent under long-term leases for office, retail and amenity space in the company's properties.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from tenants: a component of net earnings (loss), this balance represents the total income derived from long-term leases with tenants.
